stack_frame.caveat: Diagnostic only: prologue allocation includes compiler temporaries and stack-slot coloring; its delta does not imply missing source locals byte-for-byte.

cfg_alignment.method: diagnostic-only: unique exact normalized block contents and outgoing shape, followed by greedy structurally identical pairs with at least 55% instruction similarity; edges are checked only against a monotonic backbone of unique exact pairs within 5% normalized order distance; predecessor counts never make duplicate blocks unique

scope: Recorded caller traces and pool/write state with unchanged modeled external contracts; no GPU or all-input equivalence claim
